Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Corruption
Description:
Earn XP and arousal when you and a nearby player with the plugin both play animations from mods you each picked in Penumbra. Level through corruption tiers, climax into Cummy layers, bond with a regular partner, earn and wear titles, spend Sins in the shop, and opt into a full pregnancy system. Everything runs locally.
Requires Penumbra, SimpleHeels and a sync service such as Lightless. Cummy, Glamourer, Moodles and Intiface Central are optional. 18+ content.
Punchline: Earn corruption with someone nearby while your animations play.
Changelog:
- Solo scenes: tick "Counts alone" on a mod in Acts, and its animations earn with nobody nearby, at half the XP for up to 45 minutes a day. A partner joining makes it a normal scene. Climaxing alone layers you through your own Cummy.
- An "Alone time" shop section: Toy, Do Not Disturb Sign, Vanity Mirror and Afterglow Candle.
- Solo goals, five solo achievements (one hidden), each with a title that helps alone, and a Lone Wolf title in the shop.
- Text no longer gets cut off: Acts rows, pills and descriptions wrap to the window, and Your story tiles fit their labels.
